review_text: Nothing can get cheaper than this. Literally disabling most of the features for the sake of converting customers to premium subscribers. Was a premium subscriber and canceled it due to personal reasons. Didn't know that it could get this bad. Good bye Spotify, the downfall of this brand has just begun.
